0022600025.text: Atlanta hosts Washington in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game, and the Hawks (5-4, 1st in the Southeast, 6th in the East) are on a two-game winning streak in their 10th game of the season, while the Wizards (4-4, 2nd in the Southeast, 0.5 games back, 8th in the East) are coming off a loss. Atlanta is without Jalen Johnson (ankle), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Asa Newell (toe) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve). The Hawks lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 120-105 win in Washington on November 4, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
